subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public cron, Gateway protocol, plugin hook/SDK, CLI, and Control UI status?
rationale: The underlying lifecycle bug can be repaired internally, but exposing a new cross-surface status changes persisted and external contracts and cannot be accepted solely from implementation correctness.

options.title: Keep Status Internal
options.body: Preserve yielded-parent waiting internally while mapping existing public status surfaces compatibly.

options.title: Adopt Public Deferred
options.body: Accept `deferred` as a permanent public status with documented semantics and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Status Internal
recommendation.body: Preserve yielded-parent waiting internally while mapping existing public status surfaces compatibly.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the yielded-run pause behavior and has the strongest recent history across the central cron, subagent, and Discord lifecycle paths.
